price.description: A standalone monetary amount. For listing prices use #pricing instead.

amount.description: Amount in minor currency units. The number of minor units per major unit is defined per-currency by ISO 4217 and is NOT always 100: JPY has no minor unit (1000 = ¥1000), KWD and BHD have three (1000 = 1.000 KWD). Zero indicates free.

pricing.description: Full price state for a listing. A single currency covers both amounts so a regular and sale price can never disagree on currency.

regularPrice.description: Normal price in minor currency units. See #price for the minor-unit rule. Zero indicates free.

salePrice.description: Discounted price in minor currency units. When present and within the sale window, this is the effective price.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, applying to both amounts

taxInclusive.description: True if the amounts already include tax (common in the EU/UK), false if tax is added at checkout (common in the US). Apps cannot compare prices across sellers without this.

saleStartsAt.description: When the sale price takes effect. Absent means immediately.

saleEndsAt.description: When the sale price stops applying. Absent means indefinitely.

groupedItem.description: One item included in a grouped listing. Carries a denormalized title so the parent renders without fetching every child, same principle as the review variant snapshot.

item.description: AT URI of the listing or productGroup included

quantity.description: Suggested quantity of this item in the group

title.description: Denormalized title of the included item, so the group stays readable if the referenced record is unreachable or deleted

specification.description: A product property that does not vary between variants (e.g. Material, Model). Distinct from #optionAxis, which drives variant selection.

dimensions.description: Package dimensions in millimetres. Unit is fixed by the Lexicon rather than carried per-record.

postalPrefix.description: Postal/ZIP code prefix for approximate location

isRemote.description: True if this is a remote/online-only operation with no physical location

value.description: Selected value for this axis. Omit to mean 'any value on this axis' — e.g. a Red variant available in every size.

taxonomyRef.description: Pointer to a category in an externally maintained taxonomy, for depth beyond the coarse categorySlug. Keeping the deep tree outside the Lexicon means adding a category is not a schema change requiring agreement across apps.

scheme.description: Which taxonomy this id belongs to. Open value set; 'google' is the Google Product Taxonomy used across the product-feed industry.

id.description: Category identifier within that taxonomy (e.g. Google's '499954')

version.description: Taxonomy version or release date, since these trees are revised over time

path.description: Human-readable path for display and debugging (e.g. 'Cameras & Optics > Cameras > Film Cameras'). Advisory — the id is authoritative.

categorySlug.description: Coarse top-level category. Deliberately small: every added slug is a change independent apps must agree on, so depth belongs in #taxonomyRef rather than here. Open/advisory knownValues — apps maintain canonical registries. Single source of truth for listing and productGroup.
